title: One scenario. Four instruments. One net comparison.
step1_desc: Choose the underlying, time horizon, capital and leverage. The tool normalises all instruments to the same notional exposure.
step2_desc: Spreads, commissions, swap rates, theta decay, rollover and broker fees are applied from up-to-date official fee schedules.
step3_desc: Get a comparison table with total costs, per-component breakdown and Operational Efficiency Index per instrument.
